mentions.name: unpack
mentions.description: Chrome extension that organizes web-based learning into journeys. It bundles sets of websites into a 'container' using the tab group API and a sidebar, and tracks progress through visiting the pages. It uses an LLM to generate learning 'packets' from a prompt and generates websites just in time, backed by an S3 bucket.
mentions.source_excerpt: Chrome extension to organize web-based learning into journeys. Uses the tab group API and sidebar to bundle a set of websites into a "container". Sidebar tracks progress through visiting the pages. Requires an LLM token for generating "packets" from a prompt. Requires s3 bucket token because it generates web sites just in time.
